summary: This macro filters claims data to the 'Care Navigation' program and then summarizes the results by program, summing savings and counting claim IDs. It scored 1 out of 10, meaning it translates to Redshift SQL almost directly with no significant rework needed. The only two scored tools, Filter [3] and Summarize [6], both map cleanly to standard SQL (WHERE clause and GROUP BY with aggregates).

key_components.description: Filters the dataset down to rows where program equals 'Care Navigation'.
Groups the filtered data by program, summing the savings field and counting claim_id.
